Install Parsec

Choose how you want to work with filings.

Command line

Download a binary for Linux, macOS, or Windows, or build it with Cargo.

cargo install parsec-edgar-cli
Download a binary

Python

Import the Python library or run the bundled command-line tool.

pip install parsec-edgar
Python package

Rust

Add the EDGAR client and parser to a Rust project.

cargo add parsec-edgar
Rust reference

MCP

Run the local MCP server from a compatible client using uv.

uvx parsec-edgar mcp
MCP setup

When making live SEC requests, set PARSEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT to your name or organization and contact email. See usage.
